papers.title: Comparison of microstructure and mechanical properties of 316 L austenitic steel processed by selective laser melting with hot-isostatic pressed and cast material
papers.first_author_affiliation: Chair of Materials Technology, Institute for Materials, Ruhr-Universität Bochum, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Arne Röttger
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Chair of Materials Technology, Institute for Materials, Ruhr-Universität Bochum, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Karina Geenen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Chair of Materials Technology, Institute for Materials, Ruhr-Universität Bochum, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM加工316L不锈钢的力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、疲劳或生物医学植入物相关评估，与用户方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper only studies bulk material properties of 316L steel without porous structure design, fatigue testing, or biomedical implant context, and does not address stress shielding or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM、热等静压和铸造316L钢的微观结构和力学性能差异
summary_zh.method: 对三种工艺样品进行微观组织表征和拉伸测试
summary_zh.result: SLM样品强度更高但塑性低于HIP和铸造样品
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸试验和显微观察验证力学与组织关系

summary_en.motivation: To compare the microstructural and mechanical properties of 316L austenitic steel processed by selective laser melting, hot isostatic pressing, and conventional casting.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization via optical and electron microscopy, and mechanical testing including tensile and hardness measurements.
summary_en.result: SLM-processed material exhibits higher yield strength but lower ductility compared to HIP and cast counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through standard mechanical tests and microstructural analysis.

papers.title: Effects of Action Observation Therapy in Patients Recovering From Total Hip Arthroplasty Arthroplasty: A Prospective Clinical Trial
papers.first_author_affiliation: IRCCS Don Gnocchi Foundation, Milan, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Jorge Hugo Villafañe
corresponding_authors.affiliation: IRCCS Don Gnocchi Foundation, Milan, Italy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及全髋关节置换术后的康复治疗，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress/strain, micromotion, or implant stability, nor does it use finite element analysis or patient-specific biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估动作观察疗法对全髋关节置换术后患者康复效果。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性临床试验，比较动作观察组与对照组康复指标。
summary_zh.result: 动作观察疗法可改善术后功能恢复，但无生物力学数据。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effectiveness of action observation therapy on functional recovery after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A prospective clinical trial comparing rehabilitation outcomes between an action observation group and a control group.
summary_en.result: Action observation therapy improved functional recovery, but no biomechanical metrics were assessed.
